title: PT2 — Household & Personal Care Product Ingredient Investigation
summary: Investigate the active ingredients of a household or personal care product from your home, research each ingredient, and report its function, other uses, and its impact on humans and the environment.
instructions:
Your task is to investigate one household or personal care product from your home in depth. Choose from categories like:

  • Cleaning products (bleach, detergent, all-purpose cleaner, muriatic acid, disinfectant spray)
  • Personal care products (shampoo, soap, toothpaste, deodorant, lotion, sunscreen)
  • Kitchen chemicals (baking powder, vinegar, food coloring)

You will then:

  1. Photograph the product label clearly — the ingredient list must be visible.
  2. List ALL active ingredients on the label (usually 3–8 ingredients).
  3. For each active ingredient, research and report:
    • Chemical name and formula
    • Brief description — what the chemical is
    • Function — why it's in the product
    • Other uses — non-household applications (industrial, medical, agricultural)
    • Human impact — benefits and potential risks (skin irritation, toxicity if misused, etc.)
    • Environmental impact — effects on water, soil, air, and wildlife
  4. Reference the appropriate agencies: DTI, FDA Philippines, or DENR — and explain their role in regulating this product.
  5. Recommend safe use and disposal practices for the product.
  6. End with a personal reflection on how the investigation changed your understanding of household chemistry.

Format: 4–6 page PDF report with photos and a reference list. Submit as a file, or paste a share link.
requirements: Product chosen from household or personal care category
Clear photo of the label with all ingredients visible
All active ingredients listed and researched
Chemical name + formula for each ingredient
Function, other uses, human impact, environmental impact per ingredient
Reference to DTI, FDA, or DENR role in regulation
Citations of all sources used (APA or MLA)

rubric.criterion: Completeness of ingredient research (all listed, all researched)
Accuracy of chemical information (names, formulas, functions)
Depth of human and environmental impact analysis
Correct referencing of DTI / FDA / DENR roles
Quality of safe-use and disposal recommendations
